ji ltar bud med lus la dri bcas gos gyon mi sdug gzugs ldan pa// sa bdag mngal na gnas kyang mgon med khang par sdug bsngal mchog myong ltar// de bzhin bdag rang nang gnas mgon yod gyur kyang mgon med blo ldan pa/ 'gro ba nyon mongs dbang gis yid ma zhi ba sdug bsngal gzhi la gnas// zhes pa'o// dgu pa sa 'dam gyi nang na gser zhun ma'i sku yod pa bzhin/ dag pa sa gsum la brten pa'i dri ma'i sbub na/ snying po sprul pa'i sku yod par bstan pa la/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan ni/ ji ltar nang gis gser zhun gzugs rgyas pa// zhi ba phyi rol sa yi rang bzhin can/ mthong nas de shes pa dag nang gis gser// sbyong phyir phyi rol sgrib pa sel byed ltar// rang bzhin 'od gsal dri ma rnams kyang ni/ glo bur bar ni rnam par gzigs gyur nas// rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu'i 'gro ba rnams// sgrib pa dag las sbyong mdzad byang chub mchog /zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad ni/ ji ltar dri ma gser 'bar las byas sa yi nang du chud gyur gzugs// zhi de rang bzhin mkhas pas rig nas sa dag sel bar byed pa ltar// de bzhin kun mkhyen dag pa'i gser 'dra zhi ba'i yid ni mkhyen gyur nas/ chos 'chad tshul gyis brteg spyad bsgrub pas sgrib pa dag ni sel bar mdzad// zhes pa'o// gsum pa dpe dgu'i don bsdu ba ni/ padma srog chags bung ba dang*// sbun pa dang ni mi gtsang sa// 'bras shun gos rul bud med kyi/ mngal dang sa yi sbubs na yang*// sangs rgyas sbrang rtsi snying po bzhin// gser bzhin gter bzhin ljon pa bzhin// rin chen sku dang 'khor lo yis// bsgyur ba bzhin dang gser gzugs bzhin// zhes pa'o// gsum pa dri ma sbyong tshul la lnga ste/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba dang*/ gang zag gang gi rgyud la yod pa dang*/ dri ma dgu dpe don sbyar nas bshad pa'o// de la dang po spyir bstan pa ni/

sems can khams kyis nyon mongs sbubs// ma 'brel thog ma med pa nas// sems gyi rin chen dri med ni// thog ma med pa yin par brjod// zhes bya ba gsungs te/ sems can gyis rgyud la yod pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang*/ khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ni bdag nyid gcig pa dang de byung gi 'brel pa gang yang med de/ glo bur gyi dri ma rnams ni med bzhin du snang ba sprin dang rmi lam lta bu yin zhing*/ khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ni rtag pa/ brten pa zhi ba/ g.yung drung gi bdag nyid du gdod ma nas gnas pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ bag la nyal gsum/ kun ldang drag po dang bzhi/ ma rig bag chags dang lnga/ theg pa thun mong ba'i mthong spang ba/ bsgom spang gnyis dang bdun/ ma dag sa bdun gyi dri ma dang brgyad/ dag pa sa gsum gyi dri ma/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gzhom bya dang dgu ste/ de dag kyang*/ chags dang sdang dang rmongs dang de'i// kun ldang drag dang bag chags dang*// mthong bsgom lam spang ma dag dang*// dag pa'i sa la brten pa yi// dri ma rnam dgu padma yi// sbubs sogs dpe ni rab bstan te// nye ba'i nyon mongs sbubs kyis ni/ dbye ba bye ba mtha' las 'das// zhes bya ba gsungs te/ mdor bsdu na nyon mongs pa dgu po 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa la sgrib byed du sangs rgyas kyi gzugs la sgrib byed padma'i sbubs la sogs pa ltar glo bur nyid du yod do// dgu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags bag la nyal gyi mtshan nyid kyis nyon mongs pa dang*/ zhe sdang bag la nyal kyis mtshan nyid kyis nyon mongs pa dang*/ gti mug bag la nyal gyi mtshan nyid kyis nyon mongs pa dang*/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug drag po kun nas ldang ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/ ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi sas bsdus pa dang*/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba dang*/

bsgom bas spang bar bya ba dang*/ ma dag pa'i sa la brten pa dang*/ dag pa'i sa la brten pa'o// de la 'jig rten pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rgyud la yod pa'i nyon mongs pa mi g.yo ba'i 'du byed la sogs pa'i rgyu gzugs dang*/ gzugs med pa'i khams sgrub par byed pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes kyis gzhom par bya ba gang yin ba de dag ni 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug bag la nyal gyi mtshan nyid ces bya'o// 'dod chags la sogs pa la spyod pa'i sems can gyi rgyud la yod la/ bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa'i 'du byed la sogs pa'i rgyu 'dod pa'i khams 'ba' zhig bsgrub par byed pa/ mi sdug pa bsgom pa'i shes pas gzhom par bya ba gang yin pa de dag ni/ 'dod chags dang*// zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug drag po kun nas ldang ba'i mtshan nyid ces bya'o// dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la yod pa zag pa med pa'i las 'grub pa'i rgyu dri ma med pa'i yid kyi lus bsgrub par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub kyi ye shes kyis gzhom bar bya ba gang yin ba de dag ni/ ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi sas bsdus pa zhes bya'o// slob pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ so so'i skye bo dang 'phags pa'o// de la so so'i skye bo slob pa'i rgyud la yod la/ dang po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos mthong ba'i shes pas gzhom par bya ba gang yin ba de dag ni/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba ces bya'o// 'phags pa'i gang zag slob pa'i rgyud la yod pa ji ltar mthong ba'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos bsgom pa'i shes pas gzhom par bya ba gang yin pa de dag ni bsgom pas spang bar bya ba ces bya'o// ma dag sa bdun la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i sa brgyad pa la sogs pa dag pa sa gsum bsgom ba'i shes pas gzhom par bya ba gang yin pa de dag ni/ ma dag pa'i sa la brten pa ces bya'o// mthar thug pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la yod pa brgyad pa la sogs pa sa gsum bsgom pa'i shes pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs/

rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes kyis gzhom par bya ba gang yin pa de dag ni/ dag pa'i sa la brten pa ces bya'o// gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ chags sogs nyon mongs dgu po 'di// mdor bsdus na ni go rim bzhin/ padma'i sbubs la sogs pa yi// dpe dgu dag gis yang dag bstan// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa gang zag gang gi rgyud la yod pa ni/ dri 'di dag gis byis rnams dang*// dgra bcom slob dang blo ldan rnams// rim bzhin bzhi dang gcig dang ni// gnyis dang gnyis kyis ma dag nyid// zhes bya ba gsungs te/ byis pa so so skye bo rnams ni 'dug gsum bag la nyal gsum dang*/ de dag gi kun ldang drag po dang*/ bzhi yod pas ma dag pa nyid do// nyan rang dgra bcom pa rnams kyang ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang bcas pas ma dag pa nyid do// slob lam pa rnams kyang mthong spang dang bsgom spang gnyis dang bcas pas ma dag pa nyid do// blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang ma dag sa bdun la brten pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ dag pa sa gsum la brten pa'i sgrib pa dang bcas pas ma dag pa nyid do// lnga pa dri ma dgu dpe don sbyar nas bshad pa ni/ ji ltar padma 'dam skyes de// mdun du gyur na yid dga' dang*// phyi nas dga' ba med 'gyur ba// 'dod chags dga' ba de bzhin no// ji ltar srog chags sbrang ma ni/ shin tu 'khrugs te mdung brdeg ltar// de bzhin zhe sdang skye ba na// snying la sdug bsngal bskyed par bya// ji ltar 'bras sogs snying po ni// pha rol sbun pas sgrib pa ltar// de bzhin snying po'i don mthong ba/ ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs kyis sgribs// ji ltar mi gtsang mi mthun pa/ de bzhin chags dang bcas rnams kyis// 'dod pa bsten pa'i rgyu yin phyir// kun nas ldang ba mi gtsang 'dra// ji ltar nor ni sgrib pas na// mi shes gter mi thob pa ltar// de bzhin skye la rang byung nyid// ma rig bag chags sa yis bsgribs// ji ltar myug sogs rim skyes pas// sa bon shun pa gcod pa ltar// de bzhin de nyid mthong ba yis// mthong spang rnams ni ldog par 'gyur// 'phags pa'i lam dang 'brel pa las// 'jig tshogs snying po bcom rnams kyis/

bsgom lam ye shes spang bya rnams// gos rul dag dang mtshungs par bstan// sa bdun la brten dri ma ni// mngal sbubs dri ma dag dang mtshungs// mngal sbubs bral 'dra mi rtog pa'i// ye shes rnam par smin pa bzhin// sa gsum rjes 'brel dri ma rnams// sa 'dam gos bzhin shes bya ste// bdag nyid chen po rdo rje lta'i/ ting nge 'dzin gyi gzhom bya min/ de ltar chags sogs dri ma dgu// padma la sogs dag dang mtshungs// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa ji ltar rtogs pa'i rim pa la bzhi/ rtogs rgyu mdor bstan/ de nyid rgyas par bshad/ dad pas rtogs par bstan/ ma rtogs pa'i gang zag bstan pa'o// dang po rtogs rgyu mdor bstan pa ni/ rang bzhin gsum gyi bsdus phyir khams// sangs rgyas sogs dang chos mtshungs so// 'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang*// de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyang ste// de ni dpe gsum gcig dang ni// lnga rnams kyis ni shes par bya// zhes bya ba gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ 'bras bu'i snying po'i dpe gsum gyis ni khams de chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o// gser gyi dpe gcig gis ni de bzhin nyid gyi rang bzhin du'o// gter dang shing dang rin po che'i sku dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/ gser gyi gzugs kyi dpe lngas ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum bskyed pa'i rigs kyi rang bzhin du'o// gnyis pa de nyid rgyas par bshad pa la/ chos sku rnam gnyis dang*/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ bskyed byed gnyis dang*/ bskyed bya gsum bshad pa'o// de la dang po chos sku rnam gnyis bshad pa la/ chos sku rnam gnyis dngos dang*/ de dpe don sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ chos sku rnam gnyis shes bya ste// chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang*// de yi rgyu mthun zab pa dang*// sna tshogs tshul ni ston pa'o// zhes bya ba gsung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku ni rnam pa gnyis su rtogs par bya'o// de dag kyang gang zhe na/

rtog pa chos sku dang*/ bstan pa chos sku'o// rtog pa chos sku ni/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings rnam par mi rtog pa'i spyod yul lo// de yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis so so rang gi rig par bya ba'i chos kyi dbang du byas te rtog par bya'o// de thob pa'i rgyu shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyu mthun pa ni/ gdul bya ji lta bar sems can gzhan la rnam par rig par 'gyur ro// de yang bstan pa'i chos kyi dbang du byas par rig par bya'o// bstan pa chos sku yang rnam par gnyis te/ phra ba dang rgya che ba'i chos rnam par 'jog pa'i tshul gyis dbye ba las te/ 'di lta ste/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i dbang du byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod zab mo'i chos kyi tshul ston pa dang*/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i dbang du byas te/ mdo dang*/ dbyangs kyi snyan pa dang*/ lung du bstan pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ ched du brjod pa dang*/ gleng gzhi la sogs pa rnam pa du mar sna tshogs pa'i chos rnam par 'jog pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// gnyis pa dpe don sbyar ba ni/ 'jig rten 'das phyir 'jig rten na// 'di la dpe ni mi dmigs pas// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang khams// 'dra ba nyid du bstan pa yin// phra mo zab mo'i tshul bstan ni// sbrang rtsi'i ro gcig pa bzhin te// rnam pa sna tshogs tshul bstan ni// sna tshogs sbun snying bzhin shes bya// zhes bya ba gsungs ste/ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang snying po'i dpe 'di gsum gyis ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi skus lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi khams khyab pa'i don gyi dbang du byas nas/ sems can 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can yin no zhes bstan to// gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku las phyi rol du gyur pa'i sems can de ni 'ga' yang sems can gyi khams na med de/

nam mkha'i khams las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i gzugs med pa bzhin no// gnyis pa de bzhin nyid bstan pa ni/ rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa dang*// dge dang rnam par dag pa'i phyir// de bzhin nyid 'di gser gyi ni/ gzug dang mtshungs par brjod pa yin/ zhes bya ba gsungs te/ sems gang yin pa de nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa dang rjes su 'brel kyang*/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba nyid kyis rnam par mi 'gyur ba brtan pa de gser bzang po bzhin du gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i don gyi de bzhin nyid ces brjod do// de yang log pa nyid du nges pa'i rgyu can gyis sems can thams cad la yang rang bzhin khyad par med du zin kyang*/ glo bur gyi nyon mongs pa mtha' dag rnam par dag pa las gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa ces bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ste/ des na 'dir gser gyi dpe gcig gis de bzhin nyid la dbyer med pa'i don gyi dbang du byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i de bzhin nyid sems can de dag gis snying po yin no zhes bstan pa yin no// gsum pa bskyed byed gnyis ni/ gter dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin du// rigs ni rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ thogs med rang bzhin gnas pa dang*/ yang dag blangs pa mchog nyid do// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa bskyed bya gsum bshad pa ni/ rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyis// sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin// dang pos sku ni dang po ste// gnyis pa la ni phyi ma gnyis// ngo bo nyid sku mdzes pa ni// rin chen sku 'drar shes bya ste// rang bzhin gyis ni byas min dang*// yon tan rin chen gter yin phyir// chos chen rgyal srid che ldan phyir/ rdzogs longs 'khor los bsgyur bzhin no// gzugs brnyan gyi ni rang bzhin phyir/ sprul pa gser gyis gzugs lta bu// zhes pa'o// de ltar gter dang ljon shing dang*/ rin po che'i sku dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/

gser gyis gzugs te/ dpe lhag ma lnga 'di dag gis ni sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam pa gsum bskyed pa'i rigs yod pa'i dbang du byas te// de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams sems can 'di dag thams cad kyi snying po bstan pa yin no// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ni sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam pa gsum gyis rab tu phye ba yin te/ des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams ni thob pa'i rgyu yin pas khams kyi don ni 'dir rgyu'i don to// gang gi phyir de la yang sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams grub pa'i snying po gyur pa yod mod kyi/ sems can de dag gis shes pa ma yin no// gsum pa dad pas rtog par bstan pa ni/ rang byung rnams kyis don dam de// dad pa nyid kyi rtogs bya yin// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa mi rtogs pa'i gang zag ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba// mig med pas ni mthong ba med// ces bya ba gsungs te/ mdor bsdu na gang zag bzhi po 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can mthong ba la mig dang mi ldan par rnam par bzhag pa yin te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste so so'i skye bo dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o// lnga pa snying po nyid bstan par la gnyis/ ngo bo bstan pa dang*/ stong mi stong gis tshul bstan pa'o// de la dang po ngo bo bstan pa ni/ 'di la gsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes bya ba gsungs te/ de la bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bo gang yin pa ngos 'dzin pa la/ bod 'dir 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' byung ste/ bla ma dga' ldan pa rnams ni sems bden pa stong pa'i stong nyid med dgag ni bde gshegs snying po yin no zhes zer/ bla ma sa skya pa rnams ni sems gsal ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa bde gshegs snying po bzhed/

chos rje rin po che rang byung rdo rje'i gsungs las ni/ tha mal shes pa 'di nyid la// chos dbyings rgyal ba'i snying po zer// bzang du 'phags pas btang ba med// ngan du sems can gyis ma bslad// tha snyad mang po brjod gyur kyang*// brjod pa 'di yi don mi rtog /zhes gsungs so// gang gis phyir rang bzhin gyi yongs su dag pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams 'di las bsal bar byas ba kun nas nyon mongs pa ni 'ga' yang med de/ glo bur ba'i dri ma dang bral ba ni 'di'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro// 'di la rnam par byang ba'i chos bzhag par bya ba cung zad tsam kyang yod pa ma yin te/ rnam par dbye ba med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams ni 'di'i chos nyid dang rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa stong mi stong gis tshul bstan pa ni/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can// glo bur dag gis khams stong gis// rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can// bla med chos kyis stong ma yin// zhes bya ba gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 'di ni rnam par dbye ba yod pa/ bral shes pa nyon mongs pa'i sbubs thams cad kyis ni stong ba yin la/ rnam par dbyer ba med pa bral mi shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos gang gā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa'i mi stong ngo// bzhi pa khams bstan pa'i dgos pa bshad pa la gnyis/ dris lan gyi mdor bstan pa dang*/ de rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po dris lan gyis mdor bstan pa ni/ sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der// shes bya thams cad rnam kun stong par zhes// gsungs nas yang 'dir rgyal rnams sems can la/ sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsungs// sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang*// yang dag min 'dzin yang dag chos la skur// bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gsum/

bka' bar par ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul/ tha mar khams bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de rgyas bshad do// de la dang po bka' bar par ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul ni/ yang dag mtha' ni 'dus byas kyis// rnam pa thams cad dben pa ste// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin don// sprin la sogs pa bzhin du brjod// nyon mongs sprin 'dra bya ba yi// las ni rmi lam longs spyod bzhin// nyon mongs las kyis rnam par smin// phung po sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin// sngar ni de ltar rnam bzhag nas// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa tha mar khams bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ slar yang bla ma'i rgyud 'dir ni/ nyes pa lnga dag spang ba'i phyir// khams yod nyid ces bstan pa yin// zhes pa'o// gsum pa rgyas bshad la drug /zhum pa'i skyon/ bdag gzhan mnyam par ma shes pa'i skyon/ khams ma shes nas log par 'dzin pa'i skyon/ spangs gnyen la bskur ba'i skyon/ mnyam pa nyid mi rtogs pa'i skyon/ skyon lnga bral ba'i yon tan no// de la dang po zhum pa'i skyon ni/ 'di ltar de ni ma thos pas// bdag la brnyas pa'i nyes pa yis// sems ni zhum pa 'ga' zhig la// byang chub sems ni skye mi 'gyur// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa bdag gzhan mnyam par ma shes pa'i skyon ni/ gang la byang chub sems skyes pas// bdag ni mchog ces rlom pa na// byang chub sems ma skyes la dman pa'i 'du shes rab tu 'jug /ces pa'o// gsum pa khams ma shes nas log par 'dzin pa'i skyon ni/ de ltar sems dpa' de la ni// yang dag shes pa mi skye ba// des na yang dag mi 'dzin cing*// yang dag don ni rigs mi 'gyur// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa spangs gnyen la skur ba'i skyon ni/ bcos ma glo bur ba nyid phyir// sems can skyon de yang dag min// yang dag nyes de bdag med pa// yon tan rang bzhin dag pa yin// zhes pa'o// lnga pa mnyam pa nyid mi rtogs pa'i skyon ni/ yang dag min pa'i nyes 'dzin cing*// yang dag yon tan skur 'debs pas/

blo ldan bdag dang sems can ni// mtshungs mthong byams pa 'thob mi 'gyur// zhes pa'o// drug pa skyon lnga bral ba'i yon tan ni/ 'di ltar de ni thos pa las// spro dang ston pa bzhin gus dang*// shes rab ye shes byams chen skye// chos lnga skyes phyir de las ni/ kha na ma tho med mtshungs lta// skyon med yon tan ldan pa dang*// bdag dang sems can mtshungs byams la// sangs rgyas nyid ni myur du 'thob// zhes bya ba la/ bla ma sa skya paṇa chen la sogs pa mkhas pa 'ga' zhig na re/ sems can la bde gshegs snying po yod par gsungs pa ni/ nges don sgra ci bzhin pa ma yin/ drang don dgongs pa can yin/ de'i dgongs gzhi gang yin na stong pa nyid yin/ dgos pa ni/ bdag nyid la brnyas pa sogs skyon lnga spangs pa'i phyir yin/ dngos la gnod byed ni/ de lta bu'i bde gshegs snying po sems can gyi rgyud la yod par 'dod na/ mu stegs pa dag bdag rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can yod par 'dod pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro zhes zer ro// de ni mi mtshungs ste/ mu stegs pa ni bdag tu 'dzin pa'i spros pa can yin 'dir bde gshegs snying po ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ bdag dang bdag med spros pa dag /nye bar zhi bar dam pa'i bdag /zhes gsung pa ltar/ mu stegs bzhin bdag tu yang mi 'dzin/ nyan thos bzhin bdag med du yang mi 'dzin pas/ de dag gis btags pa'i spros pa dang bral bar thogs 'grel las gsungs so// sems can la bde gshegs snying po yod pa mi 'dod na// 'di ltar de ni ma thos pas// bdag la brnyas pa'i nyes pa yis// sems ni zhum pa 'ga' zhig la// byang chub sems ni skye mi 'gyur// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i skyon lnga so na gnas par 'gyur ro// yang bla ma dga' ldan ba dag na re/ bka' bar pa las rmi lam dang sgyu ma bzhin chos thams cad stong par bshad nas/ slar yang rgyud bla ma 'dir bde gshegs snying po yod par bshad pa ni bzlos pa'i skyon du 'gyur te/

sems stong pa nyid bde gshegs snying po yin pa'i phyir snyam na de lta mod kyi sems zhum pa la sogs pa nyes pa lnga spangs pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad la bde gshegs snying po yod ces gsungs pa yin no// zhes pa'i bshad pa mdzad do// sems can gyi rgyud la sems bden pas stong ba'i stong nyid de stobs sogs yon tan rnams dang dbyer med du yod pa ni mi bzhed do// yang bde gshegs snying po ni sems bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid med dgag rkyang pa yin no zhes zer mod/ de la yon tan gyi rnam pa ci yang med pas/ bde gshegs snying po chos sku dang don gcig par bshad pa dang 'gal te/ chos sku'i don la// sangs rgyas chos dbyer med pa dang*// zhes gsung pa'i phyir ro// 'o na bde gshegs snying po gang la zer na// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de// yang dag min rtog las byung 'dod chags sogs// glo bur dri mas de nyon mongs mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa lta bu 'di nyid yin no// theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos dkon mchog gis rigs rnam par dbye ba las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i skabs te tshigs su bcad pa dang po'i don gyis bsdus pa'i bshad pa rdzogs so// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa rtogs pa byang chub bstan pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ ngo bo bstan pa dang*/ sdom gyis tshigs bcad do// dang po ngo bo bstan pa ni/ dag thob bral ba rang bzhin don// de rten zab dang rgya che dang*// bdag nyid chen po de yang ni// ji srid dus dang ji lta nyid// ces bya ba gsungs te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni/ go rim ci lta ba bzhin du don brgyad po 'di dag bstan te/ 'di lta ste/ ngo bo'i don dang*/ rgyu'i don dang*/ 'bras bu don dang*/ las kyi don dang*/ ldan pa'i don dang*/

'jug pa'i don dang*/ rtag pa'i don dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don nyid/ de la khams gang zhig nyon mongs pa'i sbubs las ma grol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes brjod pa de rnam par dag pa ni/ gnas yongs su gyur pa'i byang chub kyi ngo bo nyid du rig par bya'o// gnyis pa sdom gyi tshig bcad ni/ ngo bo rgyu dang 'bras bu dang*/ las dang ldan dang 'jug pa dang*/ de rtag bsam mi khyab nyid kyis// sangs rgyas sa ni rnam par bsdus/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la bdun te// ngo bo dang rgyu bshad 'bras bu dang*/ ldan pa dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ rtag pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ ngo bo dang rgyu mdor bstan pa dang*/ de rgyas bshad do// dang po mdor bstan ni/ rang bzhin 'od gsal zhes brjod gang yin nyi dang mkha' bzhi glo bur gyis nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin tshogs stug po'i sgrib pa yis ni bsgribs gyur pa/ dri med sangs rgyas yon tan kun ldan rtag brtan g.yung drung sangs rgyas nyid// de ni chos la mi rtog rnam 'byed ye shes dag la brten nas thob// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la bzhi/ ngo bo nyid dang*/ yon tan ldan tshul dang*/ sgrib pa'i don dang*/ bral ba'i rgyu'o// de la dang po ngo bo nyid ni/ sangs rgyas nyid ni dbyer med pa// dag pa'i chos kyis rab phye ba// nyi mkha' bzhin te ye shes dang*// spangs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid do// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa yon tan ldan tshul ni/ 'od gsal byas min dbyer med par// 'jug can gang gā'i klung gi ni// rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid// zhes pa'o// gsum pa sgrib pa'i don ni/ rang bzhin gyis ni ma grub dang*// khyab dang glo bur ba nyid kyis/ nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa de// sprin dang 'dra bar brjod pa yin// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa bral ba'i rgyu ni/

sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba yi// rgyu ni ye shes gnyis yin te// mi rtog pa dang de yi ni// rjes thob de ni ye shes 'dod// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa 'bras bu la gnyis te/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la dang po mdor bstan ni/ dri med chu ldan rim rgyas padma kheng pa'i mtsho bzhin dang*// sgra gcan kha nas thar pa'i zla ba nya ba lta bu dang*// sprin tshogs nyon mongs dag las grol ba'i nyi ma lta bur ni// dri med yon tan ldan phyir 'od zer snang ldan de nyid do// thub pa'i khyu mchog sbrang rtsi'i snying po dang*// rin chen gser dang gter dang ljon pa bzhin// dri med rin chen bde gshegs sku dang ni/ sa bdag gser gyi gzugs 'dra rgyal ba nyid/ ces pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gsum/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi 'bras bu/ dus gsum dag pa'i 'bras bu/ de dpe don dgu dang sbyar ba'o// de la dang po mnyam gzhag dang rje thob kyi 'bras bu ni/ chu mtsho sogs bzhin 'dod chags sogs// glo bur nyon mongs dag pa ni// mdor na mi rtog ye shes kyis// 'bras bu yin par rab tu brjod// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// sangs rgyas sku ni nges thob pa// de ni rjes la thob pa yin/ ye shes 'bras bu yin par bya/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa dug gsum dag pa'i 'bras bu ni/ 'dod chags rdul ni spangs phyir dang*// gdul ba bya ba'i padma la// bsam gtan chu ni 'bab phyir te// chu dag rdzing dang mtshungs pa yin// zhe sdang sgra gcan las grol bas// snying rje byams chen 'od zer gyis// 'gro ba khyab pa'i phyir na de// dri med zla ba nya ba bzhin// gti mug sprin las rnam grol bas// 'gro ba ye shes 'od zer gyis// mun pa sel phyir sangs rgyas nyid// de ni dri med nyi ma bzhin// zhes pa'o// gsum pa de dpe don dgu dang sbyar ba ni/ mi mnyam mnyam pa'i chos phyir dang*// dam chos ro ni sbyin mdzad dang*// shun pa dang ni bral phyir de// bde gshegs sbrang rtsi'i snying po bzhin// dag phyir yon tan rdzas kyis ni// dbul ba sel bar byed phyir dang*// rnam grol 'bras bu sbyin byed phyir// gser dang gter dang ljon pa bzhin// rin chen chos kyi sku phyir dang*// rkang gnyis bdag po mchog phyir dang*// rin chen gzugs kyi rnam pa'i phyir/

de ni rin chen rgyal gser bzhin// zhes bya ba gsungs te/ gnas yongs su gyur pa'i ngo bo 'jig rten las 'das pa rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ de'i rjes las thob pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu can/ bral ba'i ming can gyis 'bras bu gang yin pa de'i las ni rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par brjod do// de la rang dang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ gang zhig bag chags dang bcas pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa las thar ba'i phyir/ sgrib pa med pa'i chos kyi sku thob pa 'di ni rang gi don phun sum tshogs par brjod la/ gang zhig de'i steng du 'jig rten ci srid par lhun gyis grub pas sku gnyis kyis kun tu ston pa dang*/ bstan pa la dbang 'byor pa gnyis kyis 'jug pa 'di ni gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par brjod do// gsum pa las bshad pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ zag pa med khyab 'jigs med chos can te/ brtan zhi rtag pa 'pho ba med pa'i gnas// de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' bzhin dam pa yi/ dbang po drug don nyams su myong ba'i rgyu// 'byung med gzugs don lta dang gtam bzang ni// gtsang ma nyan dang bde gshegs tshul khrims kyis// dri gtsang snom dang 'phags chen dam chos ro// myong dang ting 'dzin reg bde nyams myong dang*// rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis zab pa'i tshul// rtog pa'i rgyur 'gyur zhib mor bsam pa na// don dam bde mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa ni// nam mkha' bzhin du rgyu mtshan rnams dang bral// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ ngo bo nyid sku dang 'brel pa'i las dang*/ gzugs sku gnyis dang 'brel ba'i las so// de la dang po ngo bo nyid sku dang 'brel ba'i las ni/ mdor na ye shes gnyis po yis// las su 'di ni shes bya ste// grol ba'i sku ni rdzogs pa dang*// chos kyi sku ni sbyong ba'o// rnam grol chos kyi sku dag ni/ rnam gnyis rnam gcig shes bya ste// zag pa med phyir khyab pa'i phyir// 'dus ma byas pa'i gnas nyid phyir// nyon mongs rnams ni bag chags dang*// bcas pa 'gag phyir zag med de// chags med thogs pa med pa'i phyir// ye shes khyab pa nyid du brjod// gtan du 'jig pa med pa yi// rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas// 'jigs med nyid ni brtan pa ste// brtan sogs rnams kyis de bshad do// 'jigs pa rnam bzhir shes bya ste// brtan sogs dag la bzlogs phyir ro// myags dang rnam 'gyur chad pa dang*// bsam mi khyab sgyu 'pho ba ste// de med phyir na brtan zhi dang*// rtag dang 'pho med shes par bya// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa gzugs sku gnyis dang 'brel pa'i las ni/

dri med shes de dkar po yis// chos kyi rten yin phyir na gnas// ji ltar rgyu min nam mkha' ni// gzugs mthong ba dang sgra dang dri// ro dang reg dang chos rnams ni// thos la sogs pa'i rgyu yin ltar// de bzhin sku gnyis sgrib med pa'i// sbyor bas brtan pa'i dbang don la// zag pa med pa'i yon tan dag /skye ba yi ni rgyu yin no// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa ldan pa bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ bsam med rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung nyid// rab tu zhi khyab rtog bral nam mkha' bzhin// chags med kun tu thogs med rtsub rig spangs// blta bzung med dge sangs rgyas dri ma med// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ don gnyis dbyer med du ldan pa bstan/ de bsam gyis mi khyab par bshad/ rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung gi don bstan/ chos sku khyad chos rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la dang po don gnyis dbyer med du ldan pa bstan pa ni/ rnam grol chos kyi sku dag gis// rang dang gzhan gyis don bstan te/ rang gzhan don brten de la ni/ bsam mi khyab sogs yon tan ldan// zhes bya'o// gnyis pa de bsam gyis mi khyab par bshad pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yul// sangs rgyas shes gsum yul min phyir// ye shes yul can rnams kyis ni// bsam gyis mi khyab par rtog par bya// phra phyir thos pa'i yul min te// don dam yin phyir bsam bya min// chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i// bsgom pa la sogs yul ma yin// gang phyir gzugs la dmus long bzhin// byis pas de sngon mthong ma myong*// btsas pa'i khyim nang bu chung gis// nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin 'phags pas kyang*// zhes pa'o// gsum pa rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung gi don bstan pa ni/ skye dang bral phyir rtag pa ste// 'gag pa med phyir bstan pa yin// gnyis med phyir de zhi ba ste// g.yung drung chos nyid gnas phyir ro// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa chos sku'i khyad chos rgyas pa bshad pa ni/

rab zhi 'gog pa'i bden pa'i phyir// thams cad rtogs phyir khyab pa nyid// gnas pa med phyir rtog med de// nyon mongs spangs phyir chags pa med// shes bya'i sgrib kun dag pa'i phyir// thams cad du ni thog pa med// gnyis med las su rung ba'i phyir// rtsub pa'i reg dang bral ba yin// de gzugs med phyir bltar med de// mtshan ma med phyir bzung du med// dge ba rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir// dri med dri ma spangs phyir ro// zhes pa'o// lnga pa 'jug pa bshad pa la/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan la/ ngo bo gang rtog pa dang*/ chos sku dang*/ longs sku dang*/ sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad pa'o// de la dang po ngo bo gang rtog pa ni/ thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med// gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med// chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtog pa// mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yi mthong*// gnyis pa chos sku ni/ gzhal med gang gis bye ma las 'das pa// bsam med mnyam med yon tan rnams dang ldan// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri med dbyings de ni// bag chags bcas pa'i nyes pa rnams spangs pa'o// gsum pa longs sku ni/ sna tshogs dam chos 'od zer mnga' ba'i skus// 'gro ba'i rnam grol don grub la brtson pa// mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal bzhin te// sna tshogs dngos dang de yi rang bzhin min// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad pa ni/ 'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang*// rab tu smin dang lung ston rgyu yis gzugs// gang yin de yang 'dir ni rtag gnas te// nam mkha'i khams su gzugs kyi khams bzhin no// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ dbye ba'i gzhi dang*/ de la sku gsum du dbye ba dang*/ mtshan nyid lnga dang yon tan lnga ldan gyi ngo bo nyid sku bshad/ rang bzhin thugs rje lhun grub sogs yon tan lnga ldan gyi longs sku bshad/

mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas sprul sku bshad/ khyad par gsungs pa'i 'phrin las go rim dang bcas pa bshad/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don dang*/ brten dang rten pa bstan pa'o// de la dang po dbye ba'i gzhi ni// rang 'byung rnams kyis thams cad mkhyen// sangs rgyas nyid ces gang brjod pa// mchog tu mya ngan 'das bsam med// dgra bcom so so'i bdag 'gyur ba// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa de la sku gsum du dbye ba ni/ de dbye zab dang rgya che dang*// bdag nyid chen po'i yon tan gyis// chos kyi rab phye rang bzhin la// sogs pa'i sku gsum dag gis 'jug /zhes pa'o// gsum pa mtshan nyid lnga dang yon tan lnga ldan gyi ngo bo nyid sku bshad pa ni/ de la sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni// ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid lnga// mdor na yon tan lnga dang ni// ldan pa nyid du rig par bya// 'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med// mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spangs// nyon mongs shes bya'i snyoms 'jug gis// sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te// dri med rnam par rtog med dang*/ rnam 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir// chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyi ni/ zab pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba// gzhal med grangs med bsam med pa// mnyam med dag pa'i mthar thug pa'i// yon tan rnams dang yang dag par// ngo bo nyid kyi sku ldan te// rgya che'i phyir dang grangs med phyir/ rtog ge'i yul ni min phyir dang*// 'ba' zhig bag chags bcas spangs phyir// gzhal med la sogs go rim bzhin// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa rang bzhin thugs rje lhun grub sogs yon tan lnga ldan gyi longs sku bshad pa ni/ sna tshogs chos la rdzogs longs spyod// rang bzhin chos ni snang phyir dang*// thugs rje dag pa'i rgyu mthun pa// 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad phyir dang*// rnam par rtog med lhun grub par// 'dod pa ji bzhin yongs skong phyir// yid bzhin nor mthu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// rdzogs par longs spyod rnam par gnas// brjod ston mdzad rgyun mi 'chad dang*// mngon par 'du byed med pa dang*// de yi ngo bo mi ston la// 'dir ni sna tshogs rnam lngar brjod// ji ltar tshon ni sna tshogs kyis// nor bu de dngos min snang ltar// de bzhin 'gro rkyen sna tshogs pas// khyab bdag de dngos min pa snang*// zhes pa'o// lnga pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas sprul sku bshad pa ni/

thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen// 'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis// skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*// dga' ldan nas ni 'pho ba dang*// lhums su 'jug dang bltam pa dang*// bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*// btsun mo 'khor dgyes rol pa dang*// nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*// byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*// bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni// byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*// mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams// yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su// srid pa ci srid gnas par ston// zhes pa'o// drug pa khyad par gsung gi 'phrin las go rim dang bcas pa bshad pa ni/ mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang*// zhi ba'i sgra yis thabs mkhyen pas// sems can srid gsum skyo bskyed nas/ mya ngan 'das la rab 'jug mdzad/ zhi ba'i lam la rab zhugs pa// mya ngan 'das thob 'du shes can// dam chos padma dkar la sogs// chos kyi de nyid bstan pa yis// de dag sngar 'dzin las bzlog ste// thabs dang shes rab yongs bzung bas// theg pa mchog la sbyin mdzad de// byang chub mchog tu lung ston to// zhes pa'o// bdun pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don ni/ zab dang mthun ni sna tshogs dang*// byis pa'i don mthun rab 'dren phyir// 'di dag grangs bzhin zab pa dang*// rgya che'i bdag nyid ches shes bya// 'di ni dang po'i chos sku ste// phyi ma dag ni gzugs kyi sku// zhes pa'o// brgyad pa brten dang rten par bstan pa ni/ nam mkha' la ni gzugs gnas bzhin// dang po la ni tha ma gnas// zhes pa'o// drug pa rtag pa'i don bshad pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ gzugs sku rtag pa'i rgyu mtshan bdun dang chos sku rtag pa'i rgyu mtshan gsum gyis rgyas bshad dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ rgyu mtha' yas dang sems can zad med dang*// brtse dang 'phrul dang mkhyen dang phun tshogs ldan// chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud bcom dang*// ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon po rtags/

zhes pa'o// gnyis pa gzugs sku rtag pa'i rgyu mtshan bdun ni/ lus dang srog dang longs spyod rnams// btang nas dam chos 'dzin phyir dang*// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// dang po dam bcas mthar phyin phyir// sangs rgyas nyid ni gtsang ba dang*// dag pa'i thugs rje rab 'jug phyir// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ston pa ni// de yis gnas par spyod pa'i phyir// mkhyen pas 'khor dang mya ngan 'das// gnyis su 'dzin las grol ba'i phyir// rtag tu bsam yas ting 'dzin gyis// bde ba phun sum tshogs ldan phyir// 'jig rten na ni spyod pa na// 'jig rten chos kyis gos med phyir// zhes pa'o// gsum pa chos sku rtag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi rgyas bshad ni/ 'chi med zhi ba'i gnas thob pa// 'chi bdud rgyu ba med pa'i phyir// 'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin gyis// thub pa gdod nas rab zhi'i phyir// rtag pa skyabs med rnams kyis ni// skyabs la sogs pa 'thad phyir ro// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa don bsdu ba ni/ dang po yi ni rgyu bdun gyis// gzugs kyi sku ni rtag nyid de/ phyi ma gsum gyis ston pa ni// chos kyi sku yi rtag pa nyid// ces pa'o// bdun pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshad pa la bzhi ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don brjod pa dang*/ gtan tshig brgyad rim par bshad pa dang*/ rgyu drug gis don bsdu ba dang*/ de rtog par dka' ba'o// de la dang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don brjod pa ni/ ngag yul min phyir don dam gyis bsdus phyir// rtog gnas min phyir dpe las 'das pa'i phyir// bla na med phyir srid zhi'i ma bsdus phyir// rgyal yum 'phags rnams kyis kyang bsam mi khyab// ces pa'o// gnyis pa gtan tshig brgyad rim par bshad pa ni/ bsam med brjod du med phyir te// brjod med don dam yin phyir ro// don dam rtag bya min phyir de// brtag min rjes dpag bya min phyir// dpag min bla na med pa'i phyir// bla na med pa ma bsdus phyir// ma bsdus gnas pa med phyir te// yon tan skyon rtog med phyir ro// zhes pa'o// gsum pa rgyu drug gis don bsdu ba ni/

rgyu lnga dag gis 'phra ba'i phyir// chos sku bsam gyis mi khyab ste// drug pas de yis dngos min phyir// gzugs sku bsam gyis mi khyab bo// ces pa'o// bzhi pa rtog par dka' ba ni/ bla med ye shes thugs rje che sogs yon tan gyis// yon tan pha rol son pa'i rgyal ba bsam mi khyab// des na rang byung rnams kyi tha ma'i tshul 'di ni/ drang song chen po dbang thob rnams kyis kyang rigs min// rtog pa'i byang chub bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //de'i yan lag yon tan bstan pa la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po la gsum/ don dam kun rdzob dang*/ dag thob gnyis dang*/ sdom gyis tshig bstan pa'o// dang po don dam kun rdzob ni/ rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ de la brten pa'i kun rdzob sku nyid de// bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu ni// yon tan dbye ba drug cu bzhi 'di dag /ces pa'o// gnyis pa dag thob gnyis ni/ bdag nyid kyi ni 'byor pa'i gnas// dam pa'i chos kyi sku yin te// drang srong rnams kyi brda yi sku// pha rol phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas// dang po'i sku ni stobs la sogs// bral ba'i yon tan rnams dang ldan// gnyis pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan// rnam smin yon tan dag dang ldan// zhes pa'o// gsum pa sdom gyis tshigs bstan pa ni/ stobs nyid ma rig sgrib la rdo rje bzhin// mi 'jig nyid ni 'khor du seng ge bzhin// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ma 'dres mkha' bzhin te// thub pa'i bstan pa rnams gnyis chu zla bzhin// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la drug ste/ bstan bshad dpe dang sbyar ba gsum gyis stobs bcu bshad pa dang*/ bstan bshad dpe dang sbyar ba gsum gyis mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ bstan bshad dpe dang sbyar ba gsum gyis ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad dang*// bshad pa dpe dang sbyar ba gnyis kyis mtshan bzang bshad pa dang*/

de mdo dang sbyar ba dang*/ dpe don sbyar ba rgyas bshad do// de la dang po bstan bshad dpe dang sbyar ba gsum gyis stobs bcu bshad pa la/ stobs bcu bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ dpe dang sbyar ba'o// dang po stobs bcu bstan pa ni/ gnas dang gnas min las rnams kyis// rnam smin dang ni dbang po dang*// khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang*// kun 'gro'i lam dang bsam bstan sogs// nyon mongs dri ma med pa dang*// gnas ni rjes su dran pa dang*// lha yi mig dang zhi ba dag /mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rnam pa bcu// ces pa'o// de la gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ sbyin pa'i rgyu las/ 'bras bu longs spyod 'byung ba ni gnas yin/ tshul khrims bsrung ba'i rgyu las/ 'bras bu bde 'gro mtho ris su skye ba ni gnas yin/ rgyu de las ngan 'gror skye ba ni gnas ma yin pa sogs mngon sum du mkhyen pa'o// stobs bcu phyi ma rnams kyang de bzhin du rig par bya'o// gnyis pa bshad pa ni/ gnas dang gnas min rnam smin khams dang 'gro ba mos pa sna tshogs dang*// nyon mongs rnam byang dbang po'i tshogs dang sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang*// lha yi mig dang zag pa zad tshul zhes pa'o// gsum pa dpe dang sbyar ba ni/ mi shes go cha rtsigs brtan dang*// shing rnams 'bigs dang gzhig dang gcod phyir stobs gang yin pa rdo rje bzhin/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa bstan bshad dpe dang sbyar ba gsum gyi mi 'jig pa bzhi la/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ dpe dang sbyar ba'o// dang po mi 'jigs pa bzhi bstan pa ni/ chos kun rdzogs par nub pa dang*/ gegs ni 'gog par byed pa dang*// lam ston pa dang 'gog ston la// mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa bshad pa ni/ bdag gzhan shes bya'i dngos po rnam kun shes bya shes mdzad phyir// spangs dngos spongs dang spangs mdzad phyir dang bsten bya bsten pa'i phyir// thob bya bla med shin tu dri med thob dang thob mdzad phyir// rang gzhan don bden gsungs phyir drang song gang du 'ang thog pa med// zhes pa'o// gsum pa dpe dang sbyar ba ni/

ri dwags dbang po ji ltar nags mthar rtag 'jigs med// ri dwags rnams la skrag pa med par rgyu ba ltar/ de bzhin tshogs na thub pa'i dbang po seng ge yang*// legs gnas ltos med brten pa'i rtsal dang ldan par gnas// zhes pa'o// gsum pa bstan bshad dpe dang sbyar ba gsum gyis ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad bshad pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ dpe dang sbyar ba'o// dang po bstan pa ni/ 'khrul dang ca co mi mnga' ste// ston la dran pa nyams mi mnga'// mnyam par ma bzhag thug mi mnga'// 'du shes sna tshogs kyang mi mnga'// ma brtag btang snyoms mi mnga' ste// 'dun pa brtson grus dran pa dang*// shes rab rnam grol rnam grol gyis// ye shes gzig pa nyams mi mnga'// las rnams ye shes sngon 'gro dang*// dus la ye shes sgrib pa med// de ltar bco brgyad 'di dang gzhan// ston pa'i ma 'dres yon tan min// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa bshad pa ni/ 'khrul dang ca co bsnyel dang thugs yo tha dad kyis ni 'du shes dang*/ ngang gis btang snyoms drang srong la med 'dun pa dang ni brtson 'grus dang*/ dran dang rnam dag dri med shes rab rtag tu rnam par grol ba dang*// shes bya'i don kun gzigs pa rnam grol ye shes las ni nyams mi mnga'// gang gi las gsum thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro yi rjes su 'jug pa dang*// dus gsum rtag tu thogs med nges par mkhyen pa rgya chen 'jug pa ste// 'gro bar 'jigs med dam chos 'khor lo chen po rab skor ba// thugs rje chen po dang ldan rgyal ba nyid de sangs rgyas rnams kyi brnyes/ zhes pa'o// gsum pa dpe don sbyar ba ni/ sa sogs la yod chos nyid gang yin chos nyid de ni nam mkha'i min// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid sgrib med la sogs mtshan nyid gang de gzugs la med// sa chu me rlung nam mkha' mtshungs pa 'jig rten na ni thun mong te// ma 'dres nyid ni sdug bsngal tsam yang 'jig rten dag na thun mong min// zhes bya ba gsungs ste/

de yang sku'i spyod lam la 'khrul pa mi mnga'// gsungs la ca co mi mnga'// thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba sogs bco brgyad po 'di rnams sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho na'i khyad chos yin gyis// nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas sogs gang la yang med pas de dag dang ma 'dres pa'i chos zhes bya'o// bzhi pa dpe dang sbyar ba gnyis kyis mtshan bzang bshad pa la/ mtshan bzang bshad pa dang*/ dpe dang sbyar ba'o// dang po mtshan bzang bshad pa ni/ legs gnas 'khor los mtshan pa dang*// yangs dang zhabs long mi mngon dang*/ sor mo ring dang phyag zhabs ni// dra ba yis ni 'brel pa dang*/ lpags 'jams gzhon sha can legs nyid// sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang*// byin pa e na ya 'dra gsang*// glang po bzhin du sbubs su nub// ro stod seng ge dang 'dra ba// thal gong bar med rgyas pa dang*// dpus mgo legs zlum phyag 'jam la// zlum zhing mthon dman med pa dang*// phyag ring yongs su dag pa yi// 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan dang*// mgrin pa dri med dung 'dra dang*// 'gram pa ri dwags rgyal po 'dra// tshems ni bzhi bcu mnyam pa dang*/ dkar dang tshems thag bzang ba dang*// rnam dag tshems mnyam nyid dang ni// mche ba rab mchog dkar ba nyid// ljags ring mtha' med bsam med pa// ro bro ba yi mchog nyid dang*// rang byung ka la ping ka yis// sgra dang tshangs pa'i dbyangs nyid dang*// spyan bzang utpal khyu mchog rdzi 'dra dang*// zhal mdzes dri med mdzod spu dkar ldan pa// gtsug gtor dbu ldan dag cing srab pa dang*/ lpags pa gser gyi mdog 'dra sems can mchog /ba spu legs phra 'jam zhing re re nas// sku yi gyen du g.yas phyogs 'khyil pa dang*// dbu skra dri med rin chen mthon thing bzhin// n+ya gro rdzogs pa'i ljon shing dkyil 'khor 'dra// kun tu bzang po dpe med drang srong che// sred med bu yi stobs mnga' mkhregs pa'i sku// bsam mi khyab 'bar sum cu rtsa gnyis po// 'di dag ston pas mi dbang mtshan du gsungs// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa dpe dang sbyar ba ni/

ji ltar sprin med mkha' la zla ba'i gzugs// ston ka'i chu sngon mtshor ni mthong ba ltar// de bzhin rgyal sras tshogs kyi khyab bdag gzugs// rdzogs sangs dkyil 'khor nang du mthong bar 'gyur// zhes pa'o// lnga pa mdo dang sbyar ba ni/ yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs/ 'di dag so sor rgyur bcas te// go rim ci bzhin rin chen gyis// mdo yi rjes 'brangs shes par bya// ces pa'o// drug pa dpe don sbyar ba rgyas bshad la lnga/ yon tan spyi'i dpe don sbyar bshad dang*/ bye brag tu stobs bcu'i sbyar bshad/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i sbyar bshad dang*/ dpe 'god pa'i don dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i sbyar bshad do// de la dang po yon tan spyi'i dpe don sbyar bshad ni/ mi phyed pa dang mi zhan dang*// mtshungs pa med dang g.yo med phyir// rdo rje seng ge mkha' dag pa// chu yi zla ba dpes bstan to// ces pa'o// gnyis pa bye brag tu stobs bcu'i sbyar bshad ni/ stobs sogs rnams las stobs drug dang*// gsum dang gcig gis rim pa bzhin// shes bya snyoms par 'jug pa dang*// bag chags bcas pa kun bsal bas// go cha rtsig pa shing bzhin du/ phug dang bzhig dang bcad phyir ro// brling dang snying brtan mi phyed pas// drang srong stobs ni rdo rje 'dra// gang phyir brling ba snying po'i phyir// gang phyir brtan pa mi phyed phyir/ gang phyir snying po bstan pa'i phyir// mi phyed phyir na rdo rje bzhin// zhes bya ba gsungs te/ de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis mkhyen pa'i stobs bcu ni/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi gzhig cing 'gog par mi nus pas/ rdo rje pha lam dang 'dra ba nyid do// de yang 'gyur ba med pas brling ba ste/ snying po gdod ma nas gnas pa de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i phyir// de ni rkyen gzhan gyi mi phyed pa'i phyir brten pa nyid do// 'dir mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni rnam pa gsum ste/

shes bya'i bsgrib pa go cha lta bu dang*/ snyoms 'jug gis sgrib pa rtsig pa lta bu dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ljon shing lta bu dang gsum mo// de la stobs dang po drug gis shes bya'i sgrib pa go cha lta bu phug cing stobs bdun pa sogs gsum gyis ni/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa rtsig pa lta bu bshig la/ stobs bcu pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ljon shing lta bu rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa mi 'jig pa bzhi'i sbyar bshad ni/ 'jigs med phyir dang ltos med phyir/ brten phyir rtsol ni phun tshogs pas// thub pa seng ge seng ge bzhin// 'khor gyi tshogs su 'jigs mi mnga'/ kun mngon mkhyen pas gang las kyang*/ 'jigs med par ni rnam par gnas// dag pa'i sems can dang yang bdag /mi mnyam gzigs phyir ltos pa med// thugs ni chos rnams thams cad la// rtse cig phyir na brtan pa nyid// mchog tu ma rig bag chags kyis// sa la rgal gzigs rtsal ldan no// zhes bya ba gsungs ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ 'khor gyis nang du chos gsungs pa'i tshe bdag ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes pas 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum gyi chos thams cad mngon sum du mthong ngo zhes gsungs pa la/ khyed kyi 'di lta bu mi shes sam zhes rgol ba'i 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ bdag ni chags sogs nyon mongs pa thams cad bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa yin no zhes gsungs pa la/ 'di lta bu gcig ma spangs so zhes rgol ba'i 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ lam 'di nyams su blangs pas khams gsum 'khor ba las grol nas thar pa thob pa yin no zhes gsungs pa la/ lam 'dis 'khor ba la nges par 'byin mi nus zhes rgol ba'i 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ 'di ni 'ching ba thams cad las grol ba'i rten du thar pa thob pa yin no zhes gsungs pa la/ da dung grol ba min zhes chos mthun gyi rgol ba'i 'jigs pa med pas 'khor gyis nang du seng ge'i sgra sgrog pa'o// bzhi pa dpe 'god pa'i don ni/

'jig rten nyan thos mtha' gcig tu// spyod dang blo ldan rang byung rnams// gong nas gong du blo dag ni// phra phyir dpes ni rnam pa lnga/ zhes pa'o// lnga pa ma 'dres pa'i sbyar bshad ni/ 'jig rten kun gyi nyer 'tsho'i phyir// sa chu me rlung rnams dang mtshungs// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yis// mtshan nyid las 'das nam mkha' bzhin// zhes pa'o// gsum pa don bsdu ba gsum/ chos sku'i yon tan so gnyis bsdu ba dang*/ gzugs sku'i yon tan so gnyis bsdu ba dang*/ de'i don mthong ba'i tshul lo// de la dang po chos sku'i yon tan so gnyis bsdu ba ni/ de dag yon tan sum cu ni// gnyis ni chos skus rab phye ste// nor bu rin chen 'od mdog dang*// dbyibs bzhin dbye ba med phyir ro// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa gzugs sku'i yon tan so gnyis bsdu ba ni/ mthong na tshim byed yon tan gang*// sum cu rtsa gnyis shes bya ba// sprul pa chos la rdzogs par ni// longs spyod rdzogs sku gnyis la brten// zhes pa'o// gsum pa de'i don mthong ba'i tshul ni/ dag las ring dang nye rnams la// 'jig rten rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// chu dang nam mkha'i zla gzugs bzhin// de la mthong ba rnam pa gnyis/ zhes bya ba gsungs te/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po rnam par dag pa chos sku dri ma med pa rtogs pa la ring ba/ so so skye bo rnams kyi 'jig rten du rgyal ba'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyi brgyan pa mthong ba ni sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku ste chu nang du zla ba'i gzugs mthong ba lta bu'o// snying po chos sku dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag pa mthong ba las nye ba/ sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du mthong ba'i sku de ni longs spyod rdzogs pa ces bya ba ste/ nam mkha' mthong ba'i zla gzugs lta bu'o// yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi bstan pa ste le'u gsum pa'o//

༈ //rtog par byed pa'i rkyen 'phrin las 'jug pa'i tshul la gsum mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ dpe dang sbyar te shin tu rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ spang gnyen phul du byung ba'o// de la dang po 'phrin las lhun grub pa ni/ gdul bya'i khams dang gdul bya'i thabs dang ni/ gdul bya'i khams kyi gdul bya'i bya ba dang*/ de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyi grub par 'jug /ces pa'o// gnyis pa spang gnyen phul du byung ba ni/ yon tan rin chen mchog tshogs dang ldan ye shes chu mtsho bsod nams ye shes nyi 'od can// theg pa ma lus nges par bsgrub te mtha' dang dbus med rgya chen nam mkha' ltar khyab pa/ sangs rgyas nyid ni yon tan dri ma med gter sems can kun la khyad med rnams gzigs nas// nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin gyis dra ba sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs rje'i rlung gis rnam par gtor// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ yul du mi 'gal bar 'jug pa gnyis kyi bstan pa / de bshad pa'o// de la dang po rnam par mi rtog pa dang yul du mi 'gal bar 'jug pa gnyis kyi bstan pa ni/ gang gis gang gis 'dul ba yis// bya gang gang du gang gi tshe// de yi rnam rtog skye min phyir// thub pa rtag tu lhun gyis grub// gdul bya'i khams ni gang zhig gis// gdul bya'i thabs mang gang gang gis// gdul bya'i gang la gang du ni// gang tshe yul dang dus de dag /ces pa'o// gnyis pa de bshad pa lnga/ bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang dpe dang*/ de sbyar bshad dang*/ rgyu gsum gyi rgyun mi 'chad pa'o// de la dang po bstan pa ni/ nges 'byin de yi rton pa dang*// de 'bras de yi yongs 'dzin dang*// de sgrib de gcod rkyen la ni// rnam par rtog pa med phyir ro// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa bshad pa ni/

nges par 'byin pa sa bcu ste// tshogs gnyis dag ni de yi rgyu// de 'bras byang chub mchog yin te// byang chub sems can yongs su 'dzin// de sgrib yas mtha' nyon mongs dang*// nye ba'i nyon mongs bag chags dang*// dus kun tu ni de 'joms pa'i// rkyen ni thugs rje chen po yin// zhes bya ba gsung ste/ 'di'i brjod bya gnas drug ni nges par 'byin pa dang*/ rgyu dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ sems can yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ de'i sgrib pa dang*/ sgrib pa 'joms pa'i rkyen rnams so// gsum pa dpe ni/ gnas drug po ni 'di dag rnams// go rim ji bzhin rgya mtsho dang*// nyi ma dang ni nam mkha' gter/ sprin dang rlung bzhin shes par bya// ces pa'o// bzhi pa de sbyar bshad ni/ shes chu yon tan rin chen dang*// ldan phyir sa rnams rgya mtsho bzhin// sems can thams cad nyer 'tsho'i phyir// tshogs gnyis dag ni nyi ma bzhin// rgya chen mtha' dang dbus med phyir// byang chub nam mkha'i khams bzhin no// yang dag rdzogs sangs chos nyid phyir// sems can khams ni gter dang 'dra// glo bur khyab dang ma grub phyir// de yi nyon mongs sprin tshogs bzhin// de gtor ba ni nyer gnas phyir// thugs rje mi zad rlung dang 'dra// ces bya ba gsungs te/ de la sa bcu ni/ rje btsun byams pas mdzad pa'i dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ kun tu 'gro don mchog gi don// rgyu mthun don gyi mchog nyid dang*// yongs su 'dzin pa med don dang*// rgyud rnams tha dad med pa dang*// nyon mongs rnam dag min don dang*// tha dad med pa'i don nyid dang*// bri med 'phel ba med don dang*/ dbang ni rnal pa bzhi yi gnas// chos kyi dbyings la ma rig pa// nyon mongs can min sgrib pa bcu// sa bcu mi mthun phyogs rnams kyis// gnyen po dag ni sa yin no// zhes gsungs shing*/ dbyig gnyen gyi de'i 'grel pa las/

'di lta ste/ sa dang po la ni chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba'i don du rtog ste/ des bdag dang gzhan mnyam pa nyid rab tu thob bo// gnyis pa la ni mchog gi don du rtogs te/ des 'di snyam du sems te/ de lta bas na bsgrub tu mtshungs pa la bdag gi thams cad du yongs su spyad pa mngon par bsgrub pa nyid la brtson par bya'o snyam mo// gsum pa ni de'i rgyu mthun pa don gyis mchog tu rtogs te/ des chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyu mthun pa thob pa mchog tu rigs nas/ de'i phyir me'i 'obs stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i tshad tsam du yang bdag nyid mchong ngo/ bzhi pa ni yongs su 'dzin pa med pa'i don du rtog ste/ 'di ltar chos la srid pa yang ldog go /lnga pa la ni rgyud tha dad med pa'i don du rtog ste/ sems dang bsam pa rnam par dag pa mnyam pa nyid bcu rtogs so// drug pa ni kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par dag pa ma yin pa'i don du rtog ste/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la/ gang kun nas nyon mongs par 'gyur pa'am/ rnam par dag par gyur pa'i chos de gang yang med par rab tu rtog pa'i phyir ro// bdun pa la ni tha dad pa med pa'i don du rtog ste/ mtshan ma med pas mdo la sogs pa'i chos kyis mtshan ma tha dad pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// brgyad pa la ni bri ba med cing 'phel ba med pa'i don du rtog ste/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pas/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba na yang bri ba'am 'phel bar mi mthong ba'i phyir ro// dbang rnam pa bzhi ste/ rnam par mi rtog pa la dbang ba dang*/ zhing yongs su dag pa la dbang ba dang*/ ye shes la dbang ba dang*/ las la dbang ba'o// de la sa brgyad pa nyid la chos kyi dbyings dbang dang po dang*/ gnyis pa'i gnas nyid du rab tu rtogs so// dgu pa la ni ye shes la dbang ba'i gnas nyid du rtog ste/ so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa'i phyir ro// bcu pa la ni las la dbang ba'i sa nyid du rtog ste/

ji ltar bzhad pa bzhin du sprul pa rnams kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de yang sa thob pa'i 'phags pa rnams ni/ chos dbyings mngon sum du mthong ba'i ngang la ma g.yos par kun tu 'gro ba'i don la rtog pa la sogs pa 'byung bas de dag 'gal bar sems pa ni/ nges don ma rtog pa rnams kyi kha skad yin no// sa bcu po de dag ni/ rgya mtsho dang mtshungs te ye shes chu bo lta bu dang*/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la sogs pa nor bu rin po che lta bu du ma dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// rgyu bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis ni nyi ma dang mtshungs te/ phan pa dang bde ba'i mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir ro// 'bras bu sku gsum gyi bdag nyid byang chub chen po ni nam mkha' dang mtshungs te/ chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pas rgya che ba dang mtha' dang dbus med pa'i phyir ro// sems can rnams kyi khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ni rin po che'i gter dang mtshungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gang gā'i bye ma snyed rnams dang chos nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// khams bde gshegs snying po de sgrib par byed pa'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams ni sprin dang mtshungs te/ yang nas yang du glo bur du 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ ma rig pa dang ldan pa'i shes rgyud la khyab pa'i phyir dang*/ don la grub pa med pa sgyu ma dang*/ rmi lam lta bu yin pa'i phyir ro// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po ni rlung shugs drag po dang mtshungs te/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa sprin tshogs stug po lta bu gtor zhing 'joms pa'i phyir ro// lnga pa rgyu mtshan gsum gyis rgyun mi 'chad pa ni/ gzhan gyi dbang gis nges 'byung dang*// bdag dang sems can mtshungs gzigs dang*// mdzad pa yongs su ma rdzogs phyir// 'khor ba srid du rgyun mi 'chad// ces bya ba gsungs te/

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa mi srid de/ sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa ma rig pa'i dbang gis thog ma med pa'i dus nas/ khams gsum du 'khor zhing*/ rigs drug gi kha brgyud/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs la longs spyod pa dag gzigs shing*/ theg pa chen po'i rigs kyis nus pa rgyas/ bzod brlags med pa'i snying rje chen po skyes/ 'jig rten mtha' dag la/ phan bde bsgrub pa'i snying stobs chen po dang ldan pas/ bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad 'khor ba nas 'dren pa'i go cha bgos/ de'i ched du mkhyen brtse nus mthun bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas/ bsgrub nas de grub pa yin pa dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid can du mtshungs par gzigs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i mdzad pa da dung yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa nyid do// de la 'dir 'khor ba la mtha' yod dam med zer ba la/ 'khor ba thog ma'i mtha' ni phyi rol mu stegs la la dag yod par 'dod/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la nyan thos sde pa dang*/ theg chen pa gang gi lugs la yang 'khor ba la thog ma'i mtha' med par 'dod/ phyi ma'i mtha' la 'khor ba spyi mtha' med de 'khor ba stong pa'i dus med pa'i phyir/ sgos mtha' yod de sems can re re'i thar pa thob pa ni de'i 'khor ba'i mtha' ni der zad pa'i phyir ro// la la na re sems can gang yang sangs mi rgyas pa rten du 'khor bar gnas pa gcig kyang mi srid pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba yin la 'khor ba spyi'i mtha' yang yod pa nyid do ces zer ro// gsum pa dpe dang sbyar te shin tu rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ dpe don mdor bstan pa dang*/ de nyid rgyas bshad do// de la dang po dpe mdor bstan pa ni/

brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang*// nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin// de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin// nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa de nyid rgyas bshad la/ dpe dgu dang sbyar bshad/ de'i don bsdu ba/ chos mi mthun spangs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'o// dang po dpe dgu dang sbyar bshad la bdun/ sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ des khyab pa dang*/ sprul pa spro ba dang*/ ye shes 'jug tshul dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba dang*/ thugs rje chen po 'jug tshul lo// dang po sku la bzhi/ snang tshul byed las/ de gzhan don du 'gyur tshul/ gsum gyi dpes bstan pa'o// snang tshul/ don du 'gyur ba/ mi rtog kyang don bshad pa gsum gyi don bshad/ dpe don rgyas bshad dang*/ snang tshul gyis rgyu mtshan bstan pa'o// de la dang po snang tshul ni/ ji ltar bai ḍū'i dag pa yis// rang bzhin sa steng 'di gyur te// dag phyir lha yi dbang po de// lha yi bu mo'i tshogs dang bcas// rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang*// lha gnas de las gzhan dag dang*/ de yi gzhal yas sna tshogs dang*// lha rdzas rnam mang der mthong ngo// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa byed las ni/ de nas skyes pa bud med tshogs// sa yi steng na gnas pa rnams// snang ba de ni mthong 'gyur te// nged kyang ring por mi thogs par// lha dbang 'di 'drar gyur cig ces// de 'dra'i smon lam 'debs byed cing*// de thob don du dge ba ni// yang dag blangs te gnas par 'gyur// zhes pa'o// gsum pa don du 'gyur ba ni/ de dag dge ba'i las des ni// 'di snang tsam zhes de lta bur// shes pa med kyang sa steng nas// 'phos te lhar ni skye bar 'gyur// snang ba de ni shin tu yang*// rtog pa med cing g.yo ba med// de lta mod kyi sa steng na/ don chen gyis ni nye bar gnas/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa don la snang tshul ni/ de bzhin dad sogs dri med can// dad sogs yon tan bsgom pa yis// rang sems la snang rdzogs sangs rgyas// mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan pa// chags pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*// bzhugs pa dang ni gzims pa dang*// spyod lam sna tshogs mdzad pa can// zhi ba'i chos kyis gsungs pa dang*// mi gsungs mnyam par bzhag gyur pa// cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs dag

/mdzad pa gzi mdangs chen po can// sems can rnams kyis mthong bar 'gyur// zhes pa'o// de gzhan don du 'gyur ba ni// de mthong nas kyang stod ldan pa// sangs rgyas nyid phyir rab sbyor te// de rgyu yang dag blang gnas ni// 'dod pa'i go 'phang thob par byed// mi rtog kyang don byed pa ni// snang ba de ni shin tu yang*// rtogs med yang ba med pa nyid// de ltar na yang 'jig rten nang*// don chen po ni nye bar gnas/ 'di ni rang sems snang ba zhes// so so'i skye bos mi shes mod// de lta na yang gzugs mthong ste// de dag la ni don yod 'gyur// rim gyis de mthong la brten nas// theg pa 'di la gnas pa rnams/ nang gi dam pa'i chos sku ni// ye shes mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ zhes pa'o// gsum pa 'di don rgyas bshad ni/ ji ltar sa kun nyams nga'i gnas gzhan dang bral dri med bai ḍurya// gsal mdzes nor bu'i yon tan dri bral dpal ldan steng ni mnyam gyur te// dag phyir de ni lha bdag gnas sogs lha dbang lha yi gzugs shar te/ rim gyis sa yi yon tan bral phyir de ni slar yang mi snang 'gyur// de dngos thob phyir bsnyen gnas brtul bzhugs nges par sbyin sogs la phyogs pa// bud med skyes tshogs smon pa'i sems kyis me tog la sogs 'thor ba ltar/ dag pa'i baiḍurya 'dra sems la snang ba'i thub dbang thob bya'i phyir/ rang dga' sems ldan rgyal ba'i sras rnams de bzhin sems rab bskyed bar byed/ ces pa'o// bzhi pa snang tshul gyi rgyu mtshan ni/ ji ltar bai ḍur sa gzhi gtsang ma la// lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la// thub pa'i dbang pos sku yi gzug brnyan 'char// 'gro bar gzugs brnyan 'char nub rnyogs med dang*// rnyog pa'i rang sems rab 'jug dbang gis 'jug /ji ltar 'jig rten dag na gzugs snang ltar/

de bzhin yod dang zhig ces de mi lta/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa gsung la drug /dpe 'god pa dang*/ don bstan pa dang*/ dpe don gyis byed las mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad dang*/ khyad par brjod pa dang*/ gsung gi 'jug tshul mi 'gal bar bstan pa'o// dang po dpe 'god pa ni/ ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyis// sngon gyi dkar po'i mthu yis ni// 'bad dang gnas dang yid gzugs dang*// rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du// mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med dang*// zhi ba'i sgra yis bag med pa'i// lha rnams thams cad yang nas yang*// chos kyi rnga bo'i bskul byed ltar// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa don bstan pa ni/ de bzhin khyab bdag 'bad sogs dang*// bral yang 'gro ba ma lus pa// sangs rgyas gsung gis khyab mdzad de// skal ldan rnams la chos ston to// ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyis// rnga sgra rang gis las las byung*// de bzhin 'jig rten thub pas chos/ gsungs pa rang gi las las byung*// zhes pa'o// gsum pa dpe don gyi byed las mdor bstan pa ni/ 'bad gnas lus dang sems bral ba'i// sgra de ji ltar zhi bsgrub ltar// de bzhin 'bad sogs dang bral ba yi// chos 'di zhi ba bsgrub par byed// ces pa'o// bzhi pa rgyas bshad ni/ ji ltar lha yi grong na rnga sgra'i rgyun byung mi 'jigs sbyin pa ni/ nyon mongs g.yul du 'jug tshe lha min dpung rgyal rtsed mo sel ba bzhin// de bzhin 'jig rten dag na bsam gtan gzugs med la sogs rgyus byung ba/ sems can nyon mongs sdug bsngal rab 'joms zhi ba bla med lam tshul brjod// ces pa'o// lnga pa khyad par brjod pa ni/ gang phyir skyes kun sa nyid dang*// phan bde tshul khrims gsum ldan pa// de phyir thub dbyangs lha rdzas kyi// sil snyan rnams ni khyad par 'phags// lhar ni lha yi sgra chen po// sar gnas rnams kyis rnar mi 'gro// sangs rgyas rnga sgra 'khor ba yi// sa 'og 'jig rten dag tu 'gro// lhar ni lha yis sil snyan bye ba mang*// 'dod me mngon par 'phel ba'i don du sgrogs/

thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams kyi dbyangs gcig kyang*// sdug bsngal me rab zhi ba'i don du 'jug /lhar ni mdzes shing yid 'ongs sil snyan sgra// sems kyi dgod pa 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu// thugs rje'i bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungs// ting 'dzin sems gtod bsam pa skul byed nyid// mdor na ma lus 'jig rten khams rnams su'ang*// lha dang sa yi bde ba'i rgyu gang yin// de ni ma lus 'jig rten khyab snang ba/ dbyangs nyid la ni rab tu brten par brjod// ces pa'o// drug pa gsung gi 'jug tshul mi 'gal bar bstan pa ni/ ji ltar rna ba dang bral bas// phra mo'i sgra ni mi myong shing*// thams cad lha yi rna bar yang*// rna lam du ni mi 'gro bzhin// de bzhin chos phra mchog tu ni/ zhib mos ye shes spyod yul dang*// nyon mongs med yid 'ga' zhig gis// rna ba'i lam du 'gyur ba yin// zhes pa'o// gsum pa gsung gi dpe khyab pa la lnga/ sprin gyi dpe bstan pa dang*/ don brjod pa dang*/ snod kyi 'gyur tshul dang*/ 'bad med du 'jug pa dang*/ sdug bsngal sel ba'o// de la dang po sprin gyi dpe bstan pa ni/ ji ltar dbyar gyi dus na sprin// lo tog phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu// chu yi phung po 'bad med par// sa la rgyun du 'babs pa ltar// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa don brjod pa ni/ de bzhin thugs rje'i sprin las ni// rgyal ba'i dam chos chu yi char// 'gro ba'i dge ba'i lo tog rgyu/ rnam par rtog pa med par 'bebs// ji ltar 'jig rten dge ba'i lam 'jug na// rlung skyes chu char sprin gyi 'bebs pa ltar// de bzhin rtse rlung 'gro dge mngon 'phel phyir// sangs rgyas sprin las dam chos char pa 'bebs// srid la mkhyen dang brtse chen 'gyur ba dang*// mi 'gyur ma gos nam mkha'i dkyil gnas pa// ting 'dzin gzungs chu dri med snying po can// thub dbang sprin ni dge ba'i lo tog rgyu// ces pa'o// gsum pa snod kyi 'gyur tshul ni/

ji ltar bsil dang zhim dang 'jam pa dang*// yang ba'i chu ni sprin de la 'thon pa// sa la ba tshwa la sogs gnas 'brel bas// shin tu mang po'i ror ni 'gyur ba bzhin// de bzhin 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad bcu'i char// rab yang brtse sprin snying po las 'thon pa// 'gro ba'i rgyu kyi gnas kyis dbye ba las// rnam pa mang po'i ro dang ldan bar 'gyur// ltos pa med par 'jug pas ni// theg pa mchog la dang po dang*// bar ma dang ni sdang ba yis// phung po gsum ni mi dag dang*// rma bya dang ni yi dwags 'dra// dpyid mtha' sprin med pa na mi dang mkha' mi rgyu ba'i bya dag dang*/ dbyar tshe sa la char bab pa na yi dwags dag ni sdug pa ltar// snying po'i sprin tshogs dag gis chos chu byung dang ma byung ba las kyang*// chos 'dod pa dang chos la sdang ba 'jig rten na ni dpe de nyid// ces pa'o// bzhi pa 'bad med du 'jug pa ni thegs pa rab 'bebs rdo tshan dang ni rdo rje'i me ni 'bebs pa na// srog chags 'phra dang ri sul song ba dag la ji ltar sprin ltos med// 'phra dang rgya chen thigs thabs tshul gyi mkhyen pa dang ni brtse ba'i sprin// nyon mongs dag rgyur bdag lta'i bag chags dag la rnam pa kun ltos med// ces pa'o// lnga pa sdug bsngal sel ba la gsum/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ 'gyur ba rtog pa dang*/ bden bzhi'i tshul mthong ba'o// dang po sdug bsngal sel ba ni/ 'khor ba'i skye 'chi thog mtha' med der 'gro ba'i lam ni rnam par lnga/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med pa bzhin// 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med// de sdug rtag tu me mtshon kha ba rgya tshwa la sogs reg skyes bzhin// thugs rje'i sprin las dam chos char chen de rab zhi byed rab tu 'bebs// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa 'gyur ba rtog pa ni/ lha la 'chi 'pho mi la yangs tshol sdug bsngal zhes byar rtog pa'i phyir/ shes rab ldan pa lha mi'i byang chub mchog la mngon par 'dod med de// shes rab dang ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab dad pa'i rjes 'brangs las// 'di ni sdug bsngal 'di rgyu 'di ni 'gog ces shes pas mthong phyir ro// gsum pa bden bzhi'i tshul mthong ba ni/

nad ni shes bya nad kyi rgyu ni spangs bya la// bder gnas thob bya sman ni bstan par bya ba ltar// sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'gog pa dang de bzhin lam// shes bya spangs bya reg par bya zhing bstan par bya// ces pa'o// bzhi pa sprul pa spro ba la bzhi/ dpe don mdor bstan pa dang*/ de bshad pa dang*/ mthong ba'i rgyu bstan pa dang*/ sprul sku'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis bshad pa'o// de la dang po dpe don mdor bstan ni/ ji ltar tshangs pa tshangs pa yi/ gnas nas 'pho ba med bzhin du// lha yi gnas ni thams cad du// snang ba 'bad med ston pa ltar// de bzhin thub pa chos sku las// bskyod pa med par khams kun tu// skal ldan rnams la 'bad med par// sprul pa dag gis ston par mdzad// ces pa'o// gnyis pa de bshad pa ni/ ji ltar tshangs rtag gzhal yas khang las mi g.yo 'dod khams bzhugs pa ste// lha rnams kyis mthong de mthong de yang yul la dga' ba spongs byed ltar// de bzhin bde gshegs chos kyi sku la mi bskyod 'jig rten kun tu ste// skal ldan gyis mthong de yis mthong de rtag tu dri ma kun sel byed// ces pa'o// gsum pa mthong ba'i rgyu bstan pa ni/ sngon gyis rang nyid smon lam dang*// lha rnams kyis ni dge ba'i mthus// ji ltar tshangs pas 'bad med snang*// rang byung sprul sku de bzhin no// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa sprul sku'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis bshad pa ni/ 'pho dang lhums 'jug bltams dang yab kyi khabs gshegs dang*// dgyes rol ba dang dben par spyod dang bdud bcom dang*/ byang chub che brnyes zhi ba'i grong khyer lam ston dag /bstan nas thub pa bskal med mig gi lam mi 'gyur/ zhes pa'o// lnga pa ye shes 'jug tshul la drug /mdor bstan pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*/ ye shes spro ba'i tshul dang*/ du mar 'jug tshul bstan pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i rim pa bshad pa dang*/ khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul lo// de la dang po mdor bstan pa ni/

ji ltar nyi mas gdung bas dus cig tshe nyid la// pad sogs rgyas dang ku mud ta ni rab zum ba/ chu skyes bye dang zum pa'i yon tan skyon dag la// nyi ma rtog med 'dir ni 'phags pa'i nyi de bzhin// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa 'jug pa'i bya ba ni/ ji ltar nyi ma rtog med par// rang 'od gcig char spros pa yis// padma rgyas par byed pa dang*/ gzhan dag smin par byed pa ltar// de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yi// nyi ma'i dam chos 'od zer dag /'dul bya'i skye bo pad ma la// rnam par rtog pa med par 'jug /ces pa'o// gsum pa/ ye shes spro ba'i tshul ni/ chos dang gzugs kyi sku dag gis// byang chub snying po'i mkha' shar ba// kun mkhyen nyi ma 'gro bar ni// ye shes 'od zer spro bar mdzad// ces pa'o// bzhi pa du mar 'jug tshul bstan pa ni/ gang phyir gdul bya dag pa yis// chu yi snod ni thams cad la// bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni// dpag tu med pa gcig car 'char// zhes pa'o// lnga pa 'jug pa'i rim pa bshad pa ni/ rtag tu thams cad la khyab pa// chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil du ni// sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gdul bya yis// ri la ji ltar 'os par 'bab// ji ltar rgya chen 'od zer stong ldan nyi shar 'dir// 'jig rten kun tu snang bar byas nas rim gyis ni// mchog dang bar ma dman pa'i ri la 'bab de bzhin// rgyal ba'i nyi ma sems can tshogs la rim gyi 'babs// zhes pa'o// drug pa khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ zhing kun nam mkha'i mtha' spro nyi ma la med la// mi shes mun bkab shes bya'i don ston pa yang min// thugs rje'i bdag nyid sna tshogs mdog bkye'i 'od tshogs kyis// gsal ba dang ni 'gro la shes bya'i don ston mdzad// sangs rgyas grong du gshegs tshe mig dang mi ldan pa yi skye bo rnams// mthong zhing don med tshogs bral don de mthong ba las ni myong ba dang*// gti mug gis mdongs srid pa'i mtshor lhung lta ba'i mun pas sgrib pa rnams// sangs rgyas nyi ma'i 'od kyis blo snang ma mthong ba yi gnas mthong 'gyur// zhes pa'o// drug pa sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba la gsum/

mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul gyis thugs dgos 'dod 'byung ba dang*/ dpe don gsung gis gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ dpe don sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o// de la dang po thugs kyi gsang ba bstan pa ni/ ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu ni// rtog pa med kyang gcig char du// spyod yul gnas pa rnams kyis ni// bsam kun so so'i rdzogs byed ltar// de bzhin sangs rgyas yid bzhin la// brten nas bsam pa tha dad rnams// sna tshogs chos ni thos 'gyur yang*// de ni de la rnam mi rtog /ces pa'o// bshad pa ni/ ji ltar nor bu rin chen rtog med 'dod pa'i nor// 'bad pa med par gzhan pa dag la rab ster ltar// de bzhin thub pa 'bad med ji ltar 'os par ni/ gzhan gyi don du srid pa ji srid rtag tu bzhugs/ zhes pa'o// rnyed par dka' ba ni/ gang phyir rgya mtsho sa 'og gnas de la 'dod pas// ji ltar nor bu bzang po 'gro 'dir rab tu dka'// de bzhin 'gro ba kun tu skal ngan nyon mongs zin// yid 'dir bde gshegs mthong ba rnyed dka' shes par bya /ces pa'o// gnyis pa gsung gi gsang ba'i dpe ni/ ji ltar sgra brnyan gyis ni sgra// gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba// rnam rtog med cing bzo med pa// phyi dang nang dang mi gnas ltar// zhes pa'o// don ni/ de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungs// gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba// rnam thar rtog med bzo med cing*// phyi dang nang dang gnas ma yin// zhes pa'o// gsum pa sku'i gsang ba'i dpe ni/ cung zad med cing snang ba med// dmigs pa med cing rten med pa// mig gis lam las rab 'das pa// gzugs med bstan du med pa yi// mkha' dang ji ltar mtho dang dma'// mthong yang de ni de ltar min// zhes pa'o// don ni/ de bzhin thams cad sangs rgyas la// mthong yang de ni de lta min// zhes pa'o// bdun pa thugs rje chen po 'jug tshul la gnyis te/

dpe dang*/ don no// dang po dpe ni/ ji ltar sa las skyes pa kun// rtog med sa la brten nas ni// 'phel dang brten dang yang 'gyur ltar// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa don ni/ de bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa// rnam rtog med pa la brten nas// 'gro ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni// ma lus pa ni 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes pa'o// don bsdu ba la/ 'bad pa med pa'i don/ dgos pa bstan pa don bsdu dngos/ don bsdu dang po gtan tshig dgod pa/ skabs don brjod pa/ dpe dgu bstan pa/ dpe dgu bshad pa'o// de la dang po 'bad pa med pa'i don ni/ 'bad rtsol med par bya ba 'ga'// byed pa mthong med de bas na// gdul bya'i the tshom bcad pa'i phyir// dpe rnams dgu ni bstan pa yin// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa dgos pa bstan pa ni/ gang du dpe dgu 'di dag ni// rgyas par rab tu bstan gyur pa// mdo sde yi ni ming nyid kyis// de yis dgos pa bstan pa nyid// thos pa las byung shes pa yi/ snang ba rgya chen 'dis brgyan pa'i/ blo ldan myur du sangs rgyas kyis/ spyod yul kun la 'jug par 'gyur/ zhes pa'o// gsum pa don bsdu dngos ni/ de don bai ḍūr brgya byin gyis/ gzugs brnyan la sogs dpe dag ni// rnam pa dgu brjod de la ni// de yi bsdus don nges par bzung*// ston dang gsungs dang khyab pa dang*// sprul dang ye shes spro ba dang*// thugs gsung sku yi gsang ba dang*// thugs rje'i bdag nyid thob pa nyid// ces pa'o// bzhi pa gtan tshigs dgod pa ni/ 'bad rtsol rgyud kun rab zhi ba/ rnam par rtog pa med pa'i thugs/ dri med bai ḍūr brgya byin gyi// gzugs brnyan shar ba la sogs bzhin// longs spyod zhi ba dam bca' ste// rtog med thugs ni gtan tshigs so// rang bzhin don ni grub don du// dpe ni brgya byin gzugs sogs bzhin// zhes pa'o// lnga pa skabs don brjod pa ni/

'dir ni skabs don 'di yin te// ston pa la sogs rnam dgu ni// ston pa skye 'chi dang bral ba// 'bad pa med par rab 'jug pa'i// zhes pa'o// drug pa dpe dgu bstan pa ni/ gang zhig brgya byin rnga dang sprin bzhin dang*// tshangs nyi rin chen yid bzhin nor rgyal bzhin// sgra brnyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid pa'i bar// 'bad med gzhan don byed de rnal 'byor rigs// zhes pa'o// bdun pa dpe dgu bshad pa ni/ rin chen lha dbang snang bzhin ston pa ste// legs par 'dam mdzad lha yi rnga dang 'dra// khyab bdag mkhyen dang brtse chen sprin tshogs ni// mtha' yas 'gro ba srid rtse'i bar du khyab// tshangs bzhin zag med gnas las ma bskyod par// sprul pa rnam pa du mar rab tu ston// nyi bzhin ye shes snang ba rab spro gang*// rnam dag rin chen yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs// rgyal ba rnams kyi gsungs de brag cha bzhin du yi ge med// sku ni nam mkha' lta bu khyab dang gzugs med rtag pa nyid// sa bzhin 'gro ba'i dkar po'i chos kyi sman rnams ma lus pa'i// rnam pa kun tu gzhi gyur pa ni sangs rgyas sa yin no// zhes pa'o// chos mi mthun spangs pa'i sgo nas bshad pa la/ skye 'gag snang tshul/ chos mi mthun gyi dper brjod/ thugs rje las 'bras bu 'byung ba'i don bstan pa'o// de la dang po skye 'gag snang tshul ni/ dge ba bai ḍūrya 'dra yi// sems la sangs rgyas mthong ba'i rgyu// de dag pa ni mi bzlog pa'i// dad pa'i dbang po bltas pa nyid// dge ba skye dang 'jig pas na// sangs rgyas gzugs ni skye dang 'jig /brgya byin bzhin du thub pa yi// chos kyi sku yis skye 'jig med// de bzhin du ni 'bad med par// skye med 'gag med chos sku las// srid pa ji srid gnas bar du// ston pa la sogs mdzad pa 'jug /ces pa'o// gnyis pa chos mi mthun gyi dpe brjod pa ni/

dpe 'di rnams kyis bsdus pa yis/ don ni 'di yin rim pa yang*// snga ma phyi mas chos mi mthun// spangs pa'i sgo nas brjod pa yin// sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dbyangs dang mi ldan de 'dra min// lha yi rnga bzhin thams cad du// don med min pa de 'dra min// sprin chen dang mtshungs don med pa'i// sa bon spong min de 'dra min// tshangs chen bzhin te gtan du ni// smin par byed min de 'dra min// nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin gtan du ni// mun pa 'joms min de 'dra min// yid bzhin nor 'dra 'byung ba ni// rnyed par mi dka' de 'dra min// sgra brnyan bzhin te rkyen las ni// 'byung ba de dang 'dra ba min/ nam mkha' dang 'dra dge ba yis// gzhi min de dang 'dra ba min// 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa// 'gro ba'i phun tshogs ma lus pa// de gnas pa yi rten yin phyir// sa yi dkyil 'khor dag dang 'dra// ces pa'o// gsum pa thugs rje las 'bras bu 'byung ba'i don bstan pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub la brten nas// 'jig rten 'das pa'i lam 'byung phyir// dag pa'i lam las bsam gtan dang*// tshad med pa dang gzugs med 'byung*// 'phrin las kyi le'u bzhi pa'o// ༈ //gsum pa bstan chos yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba la gsum ste/ phan yon dang*/ ji ltar mdzad pa dang*/ bsngo ba don bsdu dang bcas pa'o// dang po la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don brjod/ yon tan mdor bstan/ sbyin pa las khyad par 'phags pa/ tshul khrims las khyad par 'phags pa/ bsam gtan las khyad par 'phags pa/ de'i rgyu mtshan brjod/ phan yon shin tu rgyas bshad do// de la dang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas khams dang sangs rgyas byang chub dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang sangs rgyas 'phrin las te// dag pa'i sems can gyis kyang bsam bya min/ 'di ni 'dren pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa yon tan mdor bstan ni/

blo ldan rgyal ba'i yum 'di la mos pa// sangs rgyas yon tan tshogs kyi snod gyur te/ bsam med yon tan tshogs la mngon dga' bas// sems can kun gyis bsod nams zil gyis gnon// zhes pa'o// gsum pa sbyin pa las khyad par 'phags pa ni/ gang zhig byang chub don du gnyer bas gser zhing nor bu spras pa ni// sangs rgyas zhing rdul mnyam pa nyin re chos rgyal rnams la rtag 'bul la// gzhan gang 'di las tshigs tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ sbyin pa las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'o// bzhi pa tshul khrims las khyad par 'phag pa ni/ blo ldan gang zhig bla med byang chub 'dod pas bskal pa du mar yang*// lus ngag yid kyis 'bad pa med pa tshul khrims dri med bsrung byed la// gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di// tshul khrims las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'o// lnga pa bsam gtan las khyad par 'phags pa ni/ gang zhig 'di na srid pa gsum gyi nyon mongs me 'jil bsam gtan ni// lha dang tshangs gnas mthar son rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'pho med thabs bsgom la// gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di// bsam gtan las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'o// drug pa de'i rgyu mtshan brjod pa ni/ gang phyir sbyin bas longs spyod dag ni sgrub byed cing*/ khrims kyis mtho ris bsgom pas nyon mongs spongs byed la/ shes rab nyon mongs shes bya kun spongs de yi phyir/ 'di mchog nyid de de yi rgyu ni 'di thos yin/ zhes pa'o// bdun pa phan yon shin tu rgyas bshad la lnga/ byang chub myur du 'thob pa/ byang chub sems kyi rten du gyur ba/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa/ zhar la tshogs gnyis kyi nges pa bstan pa/ sgrib pa gnyis spong pa'o// de la dang po byang chub myur du 'thob pa ni/
